services.title: Boat & Yacht Insurance
services.summary: Center consoles to yachts, bay and offshore.
services.text: Our specialty. Coverage for the vessel, the equipment on it and the liability that comes with being on the water, written around the way you actually use the boat.
services.lead: Your homeowners policy generally is not designed to provide the level of coverage a boat needs, particularly a larger or more valuable vessel. Boat insurance can protect the vessel, the equipment, your liability and other risks that come with being on the water, and the right coverage depends on your boat and how you use it.

covers.title: Vessels we insure
covers.text: Fishing boats, center consoles, bass boats, ski boats, cruisers, sailboats, yachts and other recreational watercraft. If you are not sure we can insure yours, call and we will discuss it.

covers.title: Fishing equipment
covers.text: Coverage for rods, reels, electronics and tackle varies by policy and carrier, so tell us what you carry and we will help you decide whether additional coverage is appropriate.

covers.title: Trailers
covers.text: Trailer coverage varies by policy. If the boat is transported on a trailer, say so while we are quoting so the trailer is properly addressed.

covers.title: Storage
covers.text: Coverage can apply while the boat is stored, but what is covered depends on the policy. Let us know how and where you store it, particularly out of season.

covers.title: Offshore navigation
covers.text: Policies can carry navigation limits or restrictions. Tell us where you plan to run the boat and we will look for coverage appropriate for that navigation.

covers.title: Liability on the water
covers.text: Boat liability can help protect you if you are legally responsible for injuries or property damage from a covered boating accident. Limits and provisions vary, so we talk through how you boat first.

questions.q: Why do I need separate boat insurance?
questions.a: A homeowners policy generally is not designed to provide the level of coverage needed for a boat, particularly a larger or more valuable vessel. Boat insurance can cover the vessel, the equipment, liability and other risks of being on the water.

questions.q: Do I need insurance if my boat is financed?
questions.a: Your lender will generally have its own insurance requirements, and those vary by lender and by boat. Even unfinanced, appropriate insurance helps protect the investment and provides liability protection.

questions.q: Can you insure a boat I use for fishing tournaments?
questions.a: Absolutely. Fishing boats are one of our specialties. If you fish tournaments, run offshore regularly or use the boat for other specialized activities, tell us, because those details matter to the coverage.

questions.q: What happens if I have an accident with another boat?
questions.a: Boat liability coverage can help protect you if you are legally responsible for injuries or property damage resulting from a covered boating accident. We go through your typical boating activities so you can select appropriate limits.

questions.q: What do you need to quote a boat?
questions.a: Year, make and model, length, purchase price or current value, hull identification number, engine information, where the boat is kept and used, your boating experience, any prior losses, and whether the boat is financed.

about.title: Based in Seabrook, in the heart of the Clear Lake boating community.
text: The Water Girl Insurance is the Gulf Coast's trusted specialist for boat and yacht insurance. Based in Seabrook, Texas, we serve boat owners throughout the Gulf Coast and beyond, and as an authorized agency for Progressive, GEICO, American Modern and others we provide competitive coverage for everything from center consoles to yachts. Fishing boats, bass boats and ski boats, along with cruisers, sailboats and luxury yachts, are our specialty.

Since 2007, A.J. Laird has helped boat owners navigate the unique risks that come with life on the water. With extensive marine insurance knowledge and a genuine passion for the boating lifestyle, we understand that your boat is more than just a policy. It is an investment in your freedom, your family and your adventures.

Whether you are cruising the bay, fishing offshore, enjoying a weekend with family and friends or docking at your favorite marina, we work to provide coverage designed around the way you enjoy your boat. We are not just interested in selling you a policy, and our goal is to make insurance easy to understand while providing personalized service and expert guidance every step of the way.

With multiple trusted carrier options, we look forward to building a strong and lasting relationship with you, and we work hard to provide you with the best coverage at the best available price. Protect your boat, protect your adventures, and we will help keep you covered on and off the water.

faqs.q: What types of insurance does The Water Girl Insurance offer?
faqs.a: A full range of personal insurance products, including boat and yacht, auto, homeowners, RV and motorcycle insurance. Our specialty is marine insurance, and we have extensive experience helping boat owners find coverage that fits the way they use their vessels.
No. While boat and yacht insurance is our specialty, we also offer auto, homeowners, RV and motorcycle insurance.

faqs.q: Why should I use an independent insurance agency?
faqs.a: An independent agency can compare coverage and pricing from multiple insurance carriers rather than being tied to just one company. We work with multiple trusted carriers to help you find coverage that fits your needs and budget.

faqs.q: Can you help me compare insurance rates?
faqs.a: Yes. Our online quoting process lets you compare insurance options from multiple carriers. You can start through the online quote form, or contact us directly if you would prefer to speak with someone.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get a quote?
faqs.a: It varies with the type of insurance and the information needed. The online quoting process can return live rates from multiple participating carriers in just a few minutes for eligible risks.

faqs.q: Can I get a quote even if I already have insurance?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We can compare available options and help you determine whether another policy may provide a better combination of coverage and price. There is no need to wait until your current policy expires.
